lines: Bienvenidos a la lección 6. Algo nuevo para reforzar lo que aprendiste en la última lección. Repasemos antes de comenzar la lección. En el siguiente ejercicio, tomarás el papel de solo la mujer. Esté seguro de responder antes y después. Así reforzarás tu inglés y seguirás avanzando más rápido.

segments.text: Do you drink?
Yes, I drink. And you? Do you drink?
No, I don’t drink.

segments.spanish: Ahora pregunta a tu amigo “bebes muchos?”
expected: I only drink a little bit.

segments.text: Do you drink a lot?
I don’t drink a lot. I only drink a little bit.

segments.spanish: Ahora dile a tu amigo “NUNCA bebo.”

segments.text: I never drink.

segments.spanish: Ahora pregunta a tu amigo “¿bebes todos los días?”
expected: No, I don’t drink every day.

segments.text: Do you drink every day?
No, I don’t drink every day. Do you eat a lot?

lines: Dile a tu amigo “No, no como mucho.”

segments.text: No, I don’t eat a lot.
I eat little.
Do you eat a lot?
Sometimes I eat a lot.

segments.spanish: Ahora pregunta a tu amigo “¿bebes mucha agua?”
expected: Do you drink a lot of water?
Yes, I drink a lot of water.

segments.text: Do you drink a lot of water?
Yes, I drink a lot of water.

segments.spanish: Ahora pregunta a tu amigo “¿tomas agua todos los días?”
expected: Do you drink water every day?
Yes, I drink water every day.

segments.text: Do you drink water every day?
Yes, I drink water every day.

segments.spanish: Ahora pregunta a tu amigo “¿bebes mucha agua por las mañanas?”
expected: Do you drink a lot of water in the mornings?
Yes, I drink a lot of water in the mornings.
Do you drink a lot of water in the mornings?

segments.text: Do you drink a lot of water in the mornings?
Yes, I drink a lot of water in the mornings. And you? Do you drink a lot of water in the mornings?

lines: Dile “siempre bebo mucha agua por las mañanas.”

segments.text: I always drink a lot of water in the mornings.
And in the afternoon? Do you drink a lot of water in the afternoon?

lines: Dile, "no, no bebo mucha agua por las tardes."

segments.text: No, I don’t drink a lot of water in the afternoons.

expected: Do you drink a lot of beer?
Yes, I drink a lot of beer.

segments.text: Do you drink a lot of beer?
Yes, I drink a lot of beer.

segments.spanish: Pregúntale “¿bebes mucha cerveza por las tardes?”
expected: Do you drink a lot of beer in the afternoons?
No, I don't drink a lot of beer in the afternoons.
I drink a lot of beer at night.

segments.text: Do you drink a lot of beer in the afternoons?
No, I don't drink a lot of beer in the afternoons. I drink a lot of beer at night. Does she drink?
What?
Does she drink? Your friend. Does your friend drink?

lines: Él acaba de preguntarte “Does your friend drink?” “Does your friend drink?” significa “tu amiga bebe?” Dile “ella bebe.”

segments.text: She drinks.

expected: Does she drink a lot of pop?

segments.text: She drinks a little bit.
Does she drink a lot of pop?

expected: Yes, she drinks a lot of pop.
Does she drink a lot of wine?

segments.text: Yes, she drinks a lot of pop.
Does she drink a lot of wine?

segments.spanish: Ahora dile “sí, ella siempre bebe mucho vino.”
expected: Yes, she always drinks a lot of wine.

segments.text: Yes, she always drinks a lot of wine.
She eats a lot?

lines: Dile “sí, ella siempre come mucho.”

segments.text: Yes, she always eats a lot.

expected: Do you drink a lot of wine?
No, I never drink a lot of wine.
But I drink a lot of beer.
Do they drink a lot of milk?

segments.text: Do you drink a lot of wine?
No, I never drink a lot of wine. But I drink a lot of beer. And them? Do they drink a lot of milk?

expected: Yes, they drink a lot of milk.

segments.text: Yes, they drink a lot of milk.

segments.spanish: Ahora dile “ellos beben mucha leche por las noches.”
expected: They drink a lot of milk in the evenings.

segments.text: They drink a lot of milk in the evenings.

segments.spanish: Ahora dile “ellos siempre beben mucha leche por las noches.”
expected: They always drink a lot of milk in the evenings.

segments.text: They always drink a lot of milk in the evenings.

segments.spanish: Ahora pregúntale “¿ellos comen por las mañanas?”
expected: Do they eat in the mornings?
Yes, they always eat in the mornings.
Do you guys eat in the mornings?

segments.text: Do they eat in the mornings?
Yes, they always eat in the mornings. And you guys? Do you guys eat in the mornings?

segments.spanish: Responde, “no, nunca comemos por las mañanas.”
expected: No, we never eat in the mornings.
Do you guys drink coffee in the morning?

segments.text: No, we never eat in the mornings.
Do you guys drink coffee in the morning?

segments.spanish: Responde, “sí, bebemos café por las mañanas.”
expected: Yes, we drink coffee in the mornings.

segments.text: Yes, we drink coffee in the mornings.

segments.spanish: Y ahora dile “bebemos té por la tarde.”
expected: We drink tea in the afternoon.

segments.text: We drink tea in the afternoon.

lines: Ahora escucha la siguiente conversación.

segments.text: Hello. What do you sell?
We sell fruit. Do you eat apples?
Yes, I eat apples every day.
We sell apples every day.
And wine, do you guys sell wine?
No, we don’t sell wine. But they sell wine.
Who, them?
Yes. They sell wine and beer.
I don't drink beer, but I drink a little bit of wine in the afternoon.

lines: Ahora aprendamos otro verbo en el presente simple. Y aprendemos los nombres de algunas frutas en inglés. Ahora aprendamos cómo decir el verbo "vender." Escucha y repite.

segments.text: Sell. Sell.
Sell. Sell.

lines: Escucha esta pregunta:

segments.text: Do you sell?
Yes, I sell. Yes, I sell.

lines: Escucha la misma pregunta otra vez.

segments.text: Do you sell?
I sell. I sell.
Do you sell? Do you sell?

lines: Ahora escucha esta pregunta.

segments.text: What do you sell?

lines: Ella acaba de preguntar “What do you sell?” “What do you sell?” significa “¿Qué vendes?” Ahora escucha esta pregunta.

segments.text: Do you sell fruit?

lines: Ella acaba de preguntar “Do you sell fruit?” “Do you sell fruit?” significa “¿vendes fruta?” Así es cómo dices “fruta.” Escucha y repite.

segments.text: Fruit. Fruit.
The fruit. The fruit.
The fruits. The fruits.
Do you sell fruit?
No, I don’t sell fruit. No, I don’t sell fruit.

lines: Nota que no dice “the fruits”. En inglés, cuando nos referimos a algo en general, no utilizamos el artículo definido “the” como lo haces en español. Dile otra vez, “no, no vendo las frutas.”

segments.text: No, I don’t sell fruit.
Do you sell fruit? Do you sell fruit?
Yes, I sell fruit. Yes, I sell fruit.

lines: Escucha esta pregunta.

segments.text: Does he sell?
Yes, he sells. Yes, he sells.

lines: Escucha la misma pregunta otra vez.

segments.text: Does he sell?
Yes, he sells. Yes, he sells.
Does he sell? Does he sell?
What does he sell?

lines: Escucha esta respuesta.

segments.text: He sells apples.

lines: Él acaba de decir “he sells apples.” “He sells apples” significa “él vende manzanas.” Así es cómo dices “manzana.” Escucha y repite.

segments.text: Apple. Apple.
An apple. An apple.

segments.spanish: Nota que dice “an” no “a”. Usamos “an” cuando el sustantivo o adjetivo que sigue comienza con una vocal. ¿Y cómo dirías ‘las manzanas’?

segments.text: The apples. The apples.

lines: Perfecto.

segments.text: Does he sell apples? Does he sell apples?
Yes, he sells apples. Yes, he sells apples.
Does he sell apples? Does he sell apples?

lines: Y cómo responderías “no, él no vende manzanas.”

segments.text: No, he doesn’t sell apples. No, he doesn’t sell apples.

lines: Escucha esta pregunta.

segments.text: Does he eat apples?
Yes, he eats apples. Yes, he eats apples.

lines: Perfecto.

segments.text: Do you eat apples? Do you eat apples?
Yes, I eat apples.

segments.spanish: Ahora pregunta “¿comes manzanas todos los días?"
expected: Do you eat apples every day?

segments.text: Do you eat apples every day? Do you eat apples every day?

lines: Excelente.
Solo escucha esta respuesta.

segments.text: No, I don’t eat apples every day. I eat apples every once in a while. And you? Do you eat apples every day?

segments.spanish: Responde “sí, como manzanas todos los días.”
expected: Yes, I eat apples every day.

segments.text: Yes, I eat apples every day.

segments.spanish: ¿Cómo preguntas “ella come manzanas todos los días?"?
expected: Does she eat apples every day?

segments.text: Does she eat apples every day?

lines: Escucha esta respuesta.

segments.text: No, she doesn’t eat apples every day. But she does eat avocados every day.

lines: Él acaba de decir, “But she does eat avocados every day.” “But she does eat avocados every day,” significa “Pero sí ella come aguacates todos los días.” La palabra “avocado” significa aguacate en inglés. Ahora escucha la conversación completa.

lines: Este es el fin de la lección 6. Repite esta lección tantas veces como sea necesario para que te sientas cómodo respondiendo a mis preguntas.
